title: Noctua Command Computers
description: Makes the Command Computer from CC: Tweaked have the Noctua color scheme.
body:
Literally just changes the texture of Command Computers from CC: Tweaked to have the Noctua colors. Uses (for accuracy, slightly adjusted versions of) the colors from [this tweet](https://x.com/Noctua_at/status/1625504377690787843)

This resource pack is basically just a shitpost, it's based on something my friend said in passing conversation. 

![Screenshot showing the new textures of the Noctua Command Computer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3a5c72df00a4a8f683f136dd14d9064331af5f4.png)
